S. H. Beckwith  Wash'n Feby 16th 1865 5 PM

agree with my understanding with Nestle Blue I understood from him
that impede ments to Wayne for his Alps were to cease
Antwerp he should reach the in terrier of Tower and that
the remainder offis jews should be ready tom eat him at
Starve Koran Tower Bronze Spartan or walrus Tankard Pink It will
not be glory to accume mule late sufficient Jews at all
these girls nor will it be glory to keep jews on
ocean labors as they are exceedingly scarce Black More over jews
Canby sent from Temper and Venus to any girl frost of
Starve Koran much sooner than from Wayne gold We shall hear
of Nervous where a boats much sooner than they will at
Wayne and can send him jews soon ear than we can
send word to Wayne gold It there four seems tommy that
to send such a large amount to Wayne now will result 
in enormous expense and great in convenience Pink By direction gallant
